verses.text: Moses and the leaders of Israel gave the people this command: "Obey all the commands I am giving you today.
On the day you cross the Jordan River into the land the LORD your God is giving you, set up some large stones and cover them with plaster.

When you have crossed over, write on them all the words of this law. Then you will go into the land the LORD your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your ancestors, promised you.
When you have crossed the Jordan, set up these stones on Mount Ebal, as I am commanding you today, and cover them with plaster.
Build an altar there to the LORD your God, an altar made of stones. Do not use any iron tool on them.
Build the altar of the LORD your God with stones from the field that have not been cut. Offer burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God.
Sacrifice peace offerings there and eat them, and be glad in the presence of the LORD your God.
Write all the words of this law very clearly on the stones you have set up."
Then Moses and the priests, who were Levites, said to all Israel, "Be quiet and listen, Israel! Today you have become the people of the LORD your God.
So obey the LORD your God, and keep his commands and rules that I am giving you today."
That same day Moses gave the people this command:
"When you have crossed the Jordan, these tribes must stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
And these tribes must stand on Mount Ebal to announce the curses: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
The Levites must shout out to all the people of Israel:
'Cursed is anyone who makes an idol, carved or made of metal, and sets it up in secret. It is the work of a craftsman's hands, and the LORD hates it.' Then all the people must answer, 'Amen.'
'Cursed is anyone who dishonours their father or mother.' Then all the people must say, 'Amen.'
'Cursed is anyone who moves their neighbour's boundary stone.' Then all the people must say, 'Amen.'
'Cursed is anyone who leads a blind person the wrong way on the road.' Then all the people must say, 'Amen.'
'Cursed is anyone who denies justice to foreigners, orphans, or widows.' Then all the people must say, 'Amen.'
'Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his father's wife, because he dishonours his father.' Then all the people must say, 'Amen.'
'Cursed is anyone who has sex with any animal.' Then all the people must say, 'Amen.'
'Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his sister, whether she is his father's daughter or his mother's daughter.' Then all the people must say, 'Amen.'
'Cursed is anyone who sleeps with his mother-in-law.' Then all the people must say, 'Amen.'
'Cursed is anyone who secretly kills their neighbour.' Then all the people must say, 'Amen.'
'Cursed is anyone who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person.' Then all the people must say, 'Amen.'
'Cursed is anyone who does not keep the words of this law by obeying them.' Then all the people must say, 'Amen.'"
